text: Built a music recommendation system that suggests songs using lyrics, metadata, and optional audio features. Built with Sentence-BERT for semantic lyric similarity.
Used Sentence-BERT, TF-IDF, Spotify in the implementation.

Implements: Sentence-BERT lyric embeddings for semantic similarity; TF-IDF over metadata (artist, genre, lyrics) for keyword similarity; (Optional) Spotify audio features (tempo, energy, valence, …) for re-ranking.
